mapper.sql: uid, email, pwd, nickname, type, status, rid, c_date, u_date
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_users ( email, pwd, nickname, type, status, rid, c_date, u_date ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{pwd}, #{nickname}, #{type}, #{status}, #{rid}, COALESCE(#{cDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{uDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
SELECT currval(pg_get_serial_sequence('tb_users', 'uid'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_users SET email = #{email}, pwd = #{pwd}, nickname = #{nickname}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, rid = #{rid}, u_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE uid = #{uid}
